lines.text: David asks the rulers if they judge uprightly, and says their hearts devise injustice and their hands mete out violence.
The wicked go astray from birth, with venom like a cobra that shuts its ears to the charmer.
David prays that God will shatter their teeth and tear out the fangs of the bears.
David asks that the wicked never see the sun, and says that before the pots feel burning briars, He will sweep them away.
The righteous will rejoice when avenged, and men will say there is surely a reward and a God who judges the earth.
